$$
\frac{-4 \left(a^2+b^2+c^2+d^2\right)+\left(\frac{a^2}{b}+\frac{b^2}{c}+\frac{c^2}{d}+\frac{d^2}{a}\right)^2}{(a-b)^2+(a-c)^2+(b-c)^2+(a-d)^2+(b-d)^2+(c-d)^2}
